questions.question: In a New Testament letter to believers, what message does the writer say they have heard from the beginning?
In a New Testament letter about love, what does the writer call everyone who hates his brother?
In a New Testament letter about love, how does the writer say we know what love is?

answers.text: Jesus laid down His life for us
Jesus wrote it on stone tablets
Jesus showed it to us in a vision

questions.question: A New Testament letter says that even if our hearts condemn us, what is true about God?

answers.text: God is greater than our hearts
God stays far from our hearts
